  - heading "Scale and measure drawings" [level=1]
  - paragraph:
    - emphasis: The following article was translated from English using a machine translation service.
  - paragraph: PDF Expert intelligently detects the scale of your drawing, helping you effortlessly measure distances, areas, and perimeters. All you need is to draw a line between two walls and the app will automatically calculate the distance, displaying it in appropriate units. The measurement tools are available under the Measure tab that can be added via the + button on the toolbar.
  - paragraph:
    - strong:
      - emphasis: "Note:"
    - emphasis: The construction toolset is a part of the paid subscription.
  - paragraph: "How to use the scale and measure tools:"
  - link "Mac":
    - /url: "#"
  - link "iOS":
    - /url: "#"
  - paragraph: "Here are the steps for Mac:"
  - list:
    - listitem: Open a file you’d like to work with.
    - listitem:
      - text: Select the
      - strong: Measure
      - text: tab at the top via the Plus icon on the toolbar.
    - listitem:
      - text: Select the
      - strong: Сalibrate
      - text: tool to set the scale, then choose the
      - strong: Distance
      - text: ","
      - strong: Area
      - text: ", or"
      - strong: Perimeter
      - text: tool depending on your needs.
    - listitem: Follow the onscreen instructions.
  - paragraph: When you use Calibrate tool, you can also determine the measurement units - for this, click the "mm" at the top left corner of the screen to enter Measure Settings. You can choose from millimeters, meters, inches, and feet.
  - 'link "Read next: Polygon and polyline shapes→"':
